probes.name: fabric
probes.reveals: the interconnect and its link rates — without it a collective hang cannot be told apart from a slow one, which is the whole of Track B attribution

probes.name: gpu
probes.reveals: driver and CUDA generation, and the device inventory a job is actually scheduled onto

probes.name: modules
probes.reveals: which modules this site publishes, and therefore whether a failing `module load` is a typo or a missing build

probes.name: mounts
probes.reveals: the shared filesystems a submission script can reference, and which of them is a plausible source of an I/O stall

probes.name: os
probes.reveals: distro, kernel and glibc — the drift keys that stay invisible until a job dies on one node and not its siblings
